content.user_title: Analyze Backlinks and AI Referral Traffic
content.value_statement: Backlink exports and AI referral data are difficult to compare consistently. This skill produces source-labeled profiles, trends, landing-page insights, and prioritized actions.
actual_capabilities: Profiles referring domains, authority distribution, anchor text, follow status, and link velocity from supplied backlink data.
Scores link quality and identifies toxic-link or disavow candidates with documented safeguards.
Compares competitor backlink profiles and prioritizes link-building opportunities.
Defines an AI referral channel from GA4 exports or server logs using an adaptable source regex.
Compares AI referral trends, landing pages, engagement, and conversions against organic traffic.
limitations: It cannot measure backlink counts without a backlink export or connected link database.
It cannot measure AI sessions without GA4, Search Console, analytics, or server-log data.
Referral traffic indicates an AI link, but it does not prove citation prominence.
Disavow recommendations require manual review before submission to Google Search Console.

use_cases.title: Audit a backlink profile
use_cases.description: Review referring domains, anchor distribution, toxic-link share, and prioritized cleanup actions from an exported backlink dataset.

use_cases.title: Measure AI referral performance
use_cases.description: Isolate AI-assistant sessions and compare landing pages, engagement, and conversions with organic traffic.

use_cases.title: Find competitive link opportunities
use_cases.description: Compare competitor referring domains and rank outreach prospects by relevance, authority, effort, and expected impact.

prompt_templates.title: Summarize my backlink profile
prompt_templates.prompt: Use backlinks mode for [domain]. Analyze this backlink export and summarize referring domains, anchor mix, follow ratio, authority distribution, and major concerns.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of one backlink export

prompt_templates.title: Review toxic links
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this backlink export for [domain]. Score suspicious links, calculate the toxic share, separate weak links from harmful links, and recommend manual review steps.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze AI referral traffic
prompt_templates.prompt: Use ai-referrals mode for [domain] during [date range]. Apply the source regex to this GA4 export and compare AI sessions with organic traffic.

prompt_templates.title: Build a combined off-site monitoring brief
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze these backlink, competitor, GA4, and server-log exports for [domain]. Keep backlink and AI-referral metrics separate, label every source, and identify prioritized actions.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced evidence-based monitoring across both modes

output_examples.input: Analyze the backlink export for example.com.
output: Mode: backlinks. Referring-domain growth is positive, while exact-match anchors exceed the review threshold.
Twelve domains require manual inspection; three show repeated spam indicators.
Priority actions: review flagged domains, diversify anchors, and pursue competitor-overlap prospects.

output_examples.input: Compare ChatGPT and Perplexity referrals with organic traffic for the last 90 days.
output: Mode: ai-referrals. AI assistants generated 420 measured sessions during the selected period.
AI conversion rate was 1.3 times the organic rate, but the sample remains small.
The pricing and comparison pages received the highest AI referral volume.

output_examples.input: Find competitor backlink opportunities for my product site.
output_examples.output: The report ranks shared linking domains by authority and relevance, then recommends resource-page, broken-link, and unlinked-mention outreach opportunities.

best_practices: Provide dated exports and a comparison window so every change has a clear baseline.
Label each metric as measured, user-provided, estimated, or unavailable.
Manually inspect suspicious domains before preparing or uploading a disavow file.
anti_patterns: Do not estimate backlink volume or AI sessions when source data is unavailable.
Do not combine backlink metrics and AI referral metrics into one score.
Do not treat referral traffic as proof of citation prominence in an AI answer.

faq.question: What data does backlink mode require?
faq.answer: Provide a backlink or referring-domain export, anchor data, and optional competitor domains. Without this data, the skill cannot calculate link metrics.

faq.question: What data does AI referrals mode require?
faq.answer: Provide a GA4 source and medium export, Search Console data, server logs, or a connected analytics source.

faq.question: Which AI assistants can it identify?
faq.answer: The starter pattern includes ChatGPT, Perplexity, Copilot, Gemini, Claude, DeepSeek, Doubao, Qwen, Poe, and related domains.

faq.question: Can it upload a disavow file?
faq.answer: No. It can prepare candidates and guidance, but a person should review and upload the final file.

faq.question: Does AI referral traffic prove a citation?
faq.answer: No. It shows that an AI answer linked to the site, but it does not prove citation position or prominence.

faq.question: Can it analyze both modes together?
faq.answer: It keeps both datasets separate. When a request includes both, select one mode first and run the other afterward.
